_comment: KitCut's own look, read off kitcut.ai's stylesheet (the light theme's tokens) so a proposal and the site are one company. A brand is these tokens plus a logo: copy the file for a white-label proposal and nothing in the template changes. Both fonts are local files on purpose. A web font that has not arrived when Chromium prints leaves the same pages in Segoe UI (that is how the first proposal came out), and the site's own Inter and Caveat are Latin-only subsets, while a proposal in Ukrainian needs the full fonts. make-proposal.py fails the print if any other face ends up in the PDF.
name: KitCut
